result of investigations conducted by this office into

March 5, 1937.

Henryk RETTER, Polish Jew.

Henryk RETTER, a Polish Jew, was born at Serajevo,
Yugo-Slavia on August 21, 1910, of Polish parents of Jewish
extraction. He studied in Poland until 1929 or 1930, when he
proceeded to France to complete his education. He remained in
France until the summer of 1935 when he came to Shanghai.

From 1930 until 1933, Retter studied law, economics and
commercial science at the Universities of Sorbonne (Paris),
Nancy and Caen and diplomas received by Retter have been seen
in confidence, leaving little doubt that during the period in
question, he was legitimately using his time in studying.

In 1933 and 1934 Retter was employed in Paris with one
M. SIEGEL of 20 Passage des Petites Ecuries, Paris.

In 1935, Retter, who by this time had married in Paris
a Polish Jewess named Hinda RABINOWITZ, decided that the time
was opportune for him to endeavour to support his wife and him-
self by his own labours, as up to this time he had been supported
by his parents, and after his marriage, by his parents-in-law,
who are wealthy people, controlling large seed-oil interests in
Poland. With this thought in mind he decided to come to China
to set up an import and export business in various lines. From
the time of his marriage until about two months ago, Retter has
been receiving a monthly remittance from his father-in-law.
Mrs. Retter is a qualified bacteriologist and after arrival in
Shanghai unsuccessfully tried to obtain a post with the French
Municipal Council as an analytical chemist.

Retter and his wife left France in August, 1935, travelled
overland to Venice, where they embarked on the s.s. "Conte Rosso",
on August 10, 1935. They left this vessel in Hongkong on
September 1, 1935, and remained in the Colony for about 18 days,
after which they continued their journey to Shanghai on the P. & O.
page_data.zh:
1937年3月5日。

Henryk RETTER，波兰籍犹太人。

Henryk RETTER，一名波兰籍犹太人，于1910年8月21日出生于南斯拉夫萨拉热窝（Serajevo），父母均为波兰裔犹太人。他在波兰求学至1929或1930年，随后前往法国完成学业。他在法国一直停留到1935年夏，之后来到上海。

从1930年到1933年，Retter在索邦大学（巴黎）、南锡（Nancy）大学和卡昂（Caen）大学学习法律、经济学和商业科学。经秘密查阅Retter获得的文凭，几乎可以肯定他在上述期间确实在正当求学。

1933年和1934年，Retter受雇于巴黎Petites Ecuries街20号的M. SIEGEL先生。

1935年，此时已在巴黎娶了一位名为Hinda RABINOWITZ的波兰犹太女子的Retter，认为时机已到，应尝试通过自己的劳动来养活妻子和自己，因为在此之前他一直由父母供养，婚后则由岳父母供养，其岳父母是富人，在波兰掌控着大型籽油产业。怀着这一想法，他决定来中国开展各类进出口贸易业务。从结婚直到大约两个月前，Retter一直每月收到岳父的汇款。Retter夫人是一名合格的细菌学家，抵达上海后曾试图在法租界公董局谋得分析化学师的职位，但未成功。

Retter及其夫人于1935年8月离开法国，陆路旅行至威尼斯，并于1935年8月10日登上“孔特·罗索”号（s.s. "Conte Rosso"）轮船。他们于1935年9月1日在香港下船，并在该殖民地停留了约18天，随后乘坐半岛与东方航运公司（P. & O.）的船只继续前往上海。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

s.s. "Chitral." Retter's object in visiting Hongkong was
to ascertain what opportunities there existed for him as a
new business man. He was not pleased with the prospects there
and left after a brief stay. After arrival in Shanghai on
September 22, 1935, the Retters stayed at the Metropole Hotel
until October 1, 1935 when they removed to 941 Bubbling Well
Road, which was then housing the Western Mansions.

Now during Retter's voyage to the Far East on the s.s.
"Conte Rosso", he became rather friendly with a Mr. A.H. ROACH,
British, employed in the Tea Department of Messrs. Olivier-
Chine, 95 Museum Road, who was a fellow passenger. Retter
confided his troubles and hopes in Roach, who taking a liking
to Retter, promised to do what he could to assist him in
"finding his legs" in Shanghai. Since his arrival here, Roach
has befriended him in both business and private life.

After Retter had arrived in Shanghai and put up at the
Metropole Hotel on September 22, 1935, he communicated with
Roach, who aware of the fact that Retter's finances were in
none too healthy a condition, advised him to leave the Metropole
as it was too expensive and move to a boarding-house or a
smaller hotel. Accordingly on October 1, 1935 the Retters
removed to the Western Mansions, where they resided for one
month.

On September 23, 1935 Retter first approached the local
Polish Legation authorities for the purpose of registering
himself and his wife as Polish citizens. Although Mrs. Retter
was in possession of a Polish passport issued in Paris bearing
her married name, neither she nor Retter could produce other
documentary evidence (marriage certificate, etc.) to prove to
the satisfaction of the Polish authorities that they were
legally married. As a result of this the Polish Legation felt
that Retter was possibly trying to conceal something of a
dubious nature, and communicated with its Legation in Paris
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

“奇特拉尔”号（s.s. "Chitral"）。Retter访问香港的目的是了解作为一名新商人那里有哪些机会。他对那里的前景并不满意，短暂停留后便离开了。1935年9月22日抵达上海后，Retter夫妇入住大都会酒店（Metropole Hotel），直至1935年10月1日搬至静安寺路941号，当时该处为西摩公寓（Western Mansions）。

在Retter乘坐“孔特·罗索”号前往远东的途中，他与同船乘客、英国人A.H. ROACH先生变得相当熟络。Roach受雇于博物馆路95号的Olivier-Chine公司茶叶部。Retter向Roach倾诉了自己的困境和希望，Roach对Retter产生好感，承诺将尽力帮助他在上海“站稳脚跟”。自抵达此处以来，Roach在业务和私人生活方面都对他予以关照。

1935年9月22日Retter抵达上海并入住大都会酒店后，他与Roach取得了联系。Roach深知Retter的财务状况并不宽裕，建议他离开费用昂贵的大都会酒店，搬至寄宿公寓或较小的旅馆。因此，1935年10月1日，Retter夫妇搬入西摩公寓，在那里居住了一个月。

1935年9月23日，Retter首次接触当地波兰公使馆当局，目的是为其本人及妻子注册为波兰公民。虽然Retter夫人持有一本在巴黎签发、印有她婚后姓名的波兰护照，但她和Retter均无法提供其他书面证据（如结婚证等）以令波兰当局满意地证明他们是合法夫妻。鉴于此，波兰公使馆认为Retter可能试图隐瞒某些可疑事项，遂与其驻巴黎公使馆联系，

page_data.en:
- 3 -

requesting full information regarding Retter's activities and
movements whilst in France. Following this, the Surete
Nationale (the French equivalent of Scotland Yard) conducted
investigations into Retter's affairs in France, and according
to the information transmitted to Shanghai from Paris, any
suspicions concerning Retter's activities could be regarded as
being unfounded, he having led the normal life of a foreign
student. Information was also forthcoming from Paris which
permitted the local Legation to register both Retter and his
wife as a legally married couple.

In the latter part of October, 1935 an advertisement
appeared in the North-China Daily News offering a furnished
apartment at Flat 3, House 4, Greystone Apartments, 525
Seymour Road. Roach, still playing the role of a friend,
arranged with the advertiser to take over the flat on Retter's
behalf as from November 1, 1935. The advertiser, Mr. J.E.
NIXON, British, in whose name the premises are still leased,
is the proprietor of Jas. E. Nixon & Co., Cotton and Cotton
Waste Merchants, 149 Szechuen Road. He resides at 310 Hart
Road and enjoys a good reputation locally. Retter and his
wife moved into this flat on November 1, and since that date
have paid rent of $175 per month to Mr. Nixon.

On October 9, 1935 Retter leased Post Office Box No.
1244, Mr. West, the then manager of the Western Mansions, acting
as guarantor.

On January 15, 1936, Retter took over Office No.33
located on the 3rd floor of the Capitol Building, 142 Museum
Road, having previously made arrangements with the agents,
Messrs. S.B. Shahmoon & Co., 83 Peking Road, to lease it for one
year or more at a monthly rental of $60. He used this office
for transacting such business in which he was engaged, but as
will be explained below, his business was not sufficiently
prosperous to compel him to visit the office regularly, and it
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

要求提供关于Retter在法国期间活动和行踪的完整信息。随后，法国国家警察局（Surete Nationale，相当于苏格兰场）对Retter在法国的事务进行了调查。根据从巴黎传至上海的信息，任何关于Retter活动的嫌疑均可被视为毫无根据，因为他过着正常的外国学生生活。巴黎方面还提供了信息，使得当地公使馆能够将Retter及其妻子登记为合法夫妻。

1935年10月下旬，《字林西报》（North-China Daily News）刊登了一则广告，出租西摩路525号格雷斯通公寓（Greystone Apartments）4号3室的 furnished apartment（带家具公寓）。Roach仍扮演着朋友的角色，代表Retter与广告发布者达成协议，自1935年11月1日起承租该公寓。广告发布者J.E. NIXON先生，英国人，该房产目前仍以他的名义租赁，他是四川路149号Jas. E. Nixon & Co.（棉花及废棉商人）的业主。他居住在哈同路310号，在当地享有良好声誉。Retter及其夫人于11月1日搬入该公寓，自那以后每月向Nixon先生支付租金175美元。

1935年10月9日，Retter租用了1244号邮政信箱，由时任西摩公寓经理的West先生担任担保人。

1936年1月15日，Retter接管了位于博物馆路142号首都大楼（Capitol Building）三楼的33号办公室，此前他已与代理人——北京路83号的S.B. Shahmoon & Co.公司——达成协议，以每月60美元的租金租赁该办公室一年或更长时间。他用此办公室处理其所从事的业务，但如下文所述，他的业务并未繁荣到迫使他定期前往办公室的地步，而且

page_data.en:
- 4 -

has been established that he was in the habit of only
occasionally making calls at his office - sometimes three
and four times a week and sometimes even less. All office
equipment was furnished by the agents, no telephone was
installed, no assistant was employed and nobody other than
Retter himself and the office cleaners ever put foot in the
office.

Retter gave up this office on February 28, 1937. A
confidential "look-over" the office in question on March 1,
1937 failed to reveal anything of a suspicious nature.

Regarding Retter's business activities, it has been
ascertained that he dealt in the import and export of cloth
manufactures and piece goods from and to Poland and Palestine,
and occasionally dealt in sausage casings and tea. He has
done a small but regular amount of business during the last
twelve months with Messrs. Jardine, Matheson's, Polish-Chinese
Trading Corporation Ltd., 150 Kiujiang Road and the Polish
Import and Export Co., 380 Szechuen Road. He is a member
of the Polish Chamber of Commerce, and although far from being
a "big" business man, is regarded by members of this Chamber
as being an honest and straightforward individual.

He receives very little mail from abroad and that which
does arrive is delivered to him through the medium of P.O. Box
1844.

One thing is certain - Retter is not very well-off as
regards money, inspite of the fact that his parents-in-law
until a short time ago, were in the habit of regularly sending
him remittances to enable him to support their daughter in a
fair degree of comfort.

Questioned through a third person Retter was asked why
he had been absent from Poland since 1930. In reply he stated
quite frankly in order to evade military service and that if,
and when he returned to Poland, he was "going to have a good
page_data.zh:
- 4 -

经查证，他习惯于偶尔去办公室——有时一周三到四次，有时甚至更少。所有办公设备均由代理人提供，未安装电话，未雇佣助手，除Retter本人和办公室清洁工外，从未有其他人踏入该办公室。

Retter于1937年2月28日退租了该办公室。1937年3月1日对该办公室进行的秘密“查看”未发现任何可疑迹象。

关于Retter的商业活动，经查证，他从事往返于波兰和巴勒斯坦的纺织品及匹头进出口贸易，偶尔也经营肠衣和茶叶。在过去十二个月里，他与怡和洋行（Messrs. Jardine, Matheson's）、九江路150号的波中贸易股份有限公司（Polish-Chinese Trading Corporation Ltd.）以及四川路380号的波兰进出口公司（Polish Import and Export Co.）保持着少量但定期的业务往来。他是波兰商会的成员，虽然远非“大”商人，但该商会成员视其为诚实正直之人。

他很少收到来自国外的邮件，收到的邮件均通过1844号邮政信箱转交给他。

有一点是肯定的——尽管其岳父母直到不久前还习惯定期向他汇款，使其女儿能过上相当舒适的生活，但Retter在经济上并不宽裕。

通过第三方询问，Retter被问及为何自1930年以来一直不在波兰。他坦率地回答说是为了逃避兵役，并且如果当他返回波兰时，他打算“好好尝试彻底摆脱它”。

page_data.en:
- 5 -

try to get out of it for good".

Retter spent many hours each week in the Foreign Y.M.C.A.
studying intricate chess problems, and playing chess with some
of the local experts. He was recently successful in a chess
tournament at the Y.M.C.A. He often played with one M. DISMANT,
who some years ago came under the suspicion of this office,
but according to our present enquiries no significance beyond
their mutual interest in the game can be attached to their
meetings. Dismant, it should be added, is one of the most
prominent chess players in Shanghai.

Retter's home has been thoroughly checked, but there is
no indication from its contents that he is engaged in any
subversive activities.

An unobtrusive watch was maintained over Retter's
movements for twelve days commencing from February 16, 1937,
but apart from a few business calls of a legitimate nature,
most of his time was spent at home with his wife and baby
daughter (born in the Country Hospital in the autumn of 1936)
and at the Y.M.C.A. playing chess. The surveillance, however,
revealed one very interesting aspect of a negative nature. In
the past when watches have been maintained over known agents
of the Comintern, it has been very noticeable how the suspects
have doubled, twisted and turned in their tracks and generally
resorted to methods that would confound and upset any possible
shadower. In Retter's case nothing of this kind was observed
and it is feasible to believe that were he an accredited agent
of some subversive organisation, he would have taken greater
precautions to elude any watchers than he displayed when he
was under surveillance.

During the period of investigation Retter has only been
seen out once with a person other than his wife and child and
this individual was the Chairman of the Polish Chamber of
Commerce, whose conduct is irreproachable.
page_data.zh:
- 5 -

Retter每周花费许多时间在青年会国际部（Foreign Y.M.C.A.）研究复杂的象棋残局，并与一些本地高手对弈。他最近在青年会举办的一次象棋比赛中获胜。他经常与一位M. DISMANT先生对弈，此人几年前曾引起本处的怀疑，但根据目前的调查，除了对象棋的共同兴趣外，他们的会面并无其他意义。需要补充的是，Dismant是上海最杰出的象棋选手之一。

Retter的住所已受到彻底检查，但其室内物品并未显示他参与任何颠覆活动。

自1937年2月16日起，对Retter的行踪进行了为期十二天的隐蔽监视，但除了几次正当性质的业务拜访外，他大部分时间都与妻子和幼女（1936年秋生于宏恩医院/Country Hospital）待在家里，或在青年会下棋。然而，监视揭示了一个非常有趣的负面方面。过去在对已知的共产国际代理人进行监视时，非常明显的是，嫌疑人会加倍小心，迂回曲折，通常采取各种方法使任何可能的跟踪者困惑和失措。而在Retter的案例中，未观察到此类情况，因此可以合理地相信，如果他是某个颠覆组织的认证代理人，他在受监视期间所表现出的规避监视者的预防措施，会比实际表现的更为严密。

在调查期间，Retter仅被看到与妻儿以外的人外出过一次，此人是波兰商会主席，其行为无可指责。

page_data.en:
- 6 -

In the light of information unearthed during the past
week, it was learned that Retter had made up his mind in the
early part of February of this year to leave Shanghai for
Europe. This was before the watch was placed over him and
before any enquiries had been made by this office regarding
his activities. From information in our possession, it
appears that Retter realising his business capabilities were
limited, that his opportunities for doing business and making
money were even less, and from the fact that since the beginn-
ing of January 1937, he could not hope to receive any more
remittances from his parents-in-law, owing to certain new
restrictions placed upon the export of Polish currency, he
came to the conclusion that the wisest course to adopt was to
leave China as early as possible in order to avoid starving
here.

His father-in-law, moreover, had requested him to
return to Poland and assist him (the father) in his business,
and as far as can be ascertained such was Retter's intention
after his arrival in Europe.

On February 15, 1937 Retter advised Mr. Nixon that
he would be giving up the apartment at Seymour Road on March
1, 1937. A few days prior to February 15, 1937 Retter made
his way to the Polish Legation and made formal application
for a new passport to replace the one he held, which by that
time, had expired. He was issued with Polish Passport No.
16/37 (414322) issued by the same authority on October 31,
1936. Both Retter and his wife received visas for travel in
Austria, valid for one year, on February 26, 1937 from the
Austrian Consulate-General and transit visas for one journey
through U.S.S.R. on March 1, 1937 from the Soviet Consulate-
General.

Retter, his wife and child left Shanghai on March 2,
1937 on the Soviet s.s. "Sever" for Vladivostock en route for
page_data.zh:
- 6 -

根据过去一周挖掘出的情报，获悉雷特（Retter）已于今年二月初下定决心离开上海前往欧洲。这发生在对其实施监视之前，也发生在本处就其活动展开任何调查之前。根据我方掌握的情报，雷特似乎意识到自己的商业能力有限，经商和赚钱的机会更是少之又少，且自1937年1月以来，由于波兰货币出口受到某些新限制，他已无法指望再从岳父母那里收到任何汇款，因此他得出结论，最明智的做法是尽早离开中国，以免在此挨饿。

此外，他的岳父曾要求他返回波兰并协助其（岳父）做生意，据查，这也是雷特抵达欧洲后的打算。

1937年2月15日，雷特通知尼克松（Nixon）先生，他将于1937年3月1日退租西摩路（Seymour Road）的公寓。在1937年2月15日的前几天，雷特前往波兰公使馆，正式申请新护照以替换当时已过期的旧护照。他获发了由同一机构于1936年10月31日签发的波兰护照第16/37号（414322）。1937年2月26日，雷特及其妻子从奥地利总领事馆获得了有效期为一年的奥地利旅行签证；1937年3月1日，他们又从苏联总领事馆获得了经苏联单次过境签证。

雷特携妻儿于1937年3月2日乘坐苏联轮船“谢韦尔”号（Sever）离开上海前往符拉迪沃斯托克（Vladivostock），途中经

page_data.en:
- 7 -

Poland via Siberia. The fact that Retter travelled on a
Soviet vessel when leaving Shanghai might appear, at first
sight, to confirm the suspicions that he is an agent of the
Comintern, but it has been definitely established that Retter
travelled on this particular vessel on advice tendered by Mr.
Roach. Retter asked Roach for advice as to the quickest,
easiest and cheapest way to reach Poland from Shanghai, and
bearing in mind that the trip via the D.K.K. Line to Dairen
and thence by rail to the Soviet border would entail numerous
changes, which would not be convenient when travelling with
a young baby, Roach advised Retter to book through the Soviet
Intourist Agency to Poland, using the sea-route to Vladivostock
and thence by rail - a question of one change only. Roach
even went with Retter to the agency and to the Soviet Consulate-
General and assisted Retter in making the booking and procuring
his visa. Mr. Roach is quite a well known man in Shanghai
and there is no question of his relations with Retter being
other than those of a friend. In fact the greater part of
Retter's friends and acquaintances in Shanghai, who were not
many, were introduced to him by Mr. Roach.

Retter had three banking accounts in Shanghai - the
National City Bank of New York, the Chartered Bank and the
Italian Bank for China. It is not believed that this point
has any special significance, for it is a well known fact that
business men, especially those people who are not well off,
are assisted considerably in their affairs by the fact that
they have a number of banking accounts, however small they
may be.

Retter was also a member of the Polish Charity organ-
isation Committee and is reported to have helped considerably
in alleviating distress among local Polish indigent circles.

The enquiries regarding Retter have been made very
discreetly and it must be said that from the information gained

西伯利亚前往波兰。雷特离开上海时乘坐苏联船只这一事实，乍看之下似乎证实了他是一名共产国际特工的嫌疑，但已确切查明，雷特乘坐该特定船只乃是听从罗奇（Roach）先生的建议。雷特曾向罗奇咨询从上海前往波兰最快、最便捷且最便宜的方式，考虑到经由大连汽船株式会社（D.K.K. Line）航线至大连，再乘火车前往苏联边境需多次换乘，携带幼婴旅行甚为不便，罗奇遂建议雷特通过苏联国际旅行社（Intourist Agency）预订前往波兰的行程，即先走海路至符拉迪沃斯托克，再转乘火车——全程仅需换乘一次。罗奇甚至陪同雷特前往该旅行社及苏联总领事馆，协助雷特办理预订及获取签证。罗奇先生在上海颇有名气，他与雷特的关系无疑纯属朋友关系。事实上，雷特在上海的朋友和熟人本就不多，其中大部分是由罗奇先生介绍认识的。

雷特在上海有三个银行账户——纽约花旗银行（National City Bank of New York）、渣打银行（Chartered Bank）以及意大利在华银行（Italian Bank for China）。人们认为这一点并无特殊意义，因为众所周知，商人，尤其是那些并不富裕的人，拥有多个银行账户（无论金额大小）对其事务大有裨益。

雷特也是波兰慈善组织委员会的成员，据报道，他在缓解当地波兰贫困阶层的困境方面提供了大量帮助。

针对雷特的调查进行得非常谨慎，必须指出，根据所获情报，

page_data.en:
- 8 -

there is not the slightest evidence to show that he was
actively connected with any communist apparatus in Shanghai
or in France prior to his arrival here. All avenues have
been combed for information regarding this man in the light
of subversive activities and the people who have been
confidentially approached during the course of this inves-
tigation, have expressed the opinion that Retter was too
honest and straightforward a man ever to be connected with
communists or their nefarious work.
page_data.zh:

没有任何证据表明他在抵达此处之前，曾积极参与上海或法国的任何共产主义机关的活动。鉴于颠覆活动，各方渠道均已彻底排查以搜集关于此人的情报，而在本次调查过程中被秘密接触的人士均表示，雷特为人过于诚实正直，绝不可能与共产党人或其邪恶行径有任何牵连。

Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by I. Payne D.S.I.

Inquiries conducted into the past and present activities
of a suspected communist agent, whose name was reported to be
"A. Retter", have produced the following results:-

Henryk RETTER, a Polish Jew, was born at Serajevo,
Yugo-Slavia on August 21, 1910, of Polish parents of Jewish
extraction. He studied in Poland until 1929 or 1930, when
he proceeded to France to complete his education. He remained
in France until the summer of 1935 when he came to Shanghai.

From 1930 until 1933, Retter studied law, economics
and commercial science at the Universities of Sorbonne (Paris),
Nancy and Caen and diplomas received by Retter have been seen
in confidence, leaving little doubt that during the period in
question, he was legitimately using his time in studying.

In 1933 and 1934 Retter was employed in Paris with one
one M. **〔此处转录不清〕** of 20 Passage des Petites Ecuries, Paris.

In 1935, Retter, who by this time had married in Paris
a Polish Jewess named Hinda **〔此处转录不清〕**, decided that the time was
opportune for him to endeavour to support his wife and himself
by his own labours, as up to this time he had been supported by
his parents, and after his marriage, by his parents-in-law, who
are wealthy people, controlling large seed-oil interests in
Poland. With this thought in mind he decided to come to China
to set up an import and export business in various lines. From
the time of his marriage until about two months ago, Retter has
been receiving a monthly remittance from his father-in-law. Mrs.
Retter is a qualified bacteriologist and after arrival in Shanghai
unsuccessfully tried to obtain a post with the French Municipal
Council as an analytical chemist.

亨利克·雷特（Henryk RETTER），波兰犹太人，1910年8月21日出生于南斯拉夫萨拉热窝（Serajevo），父母为波兰籍犹太裔。他在波兰学习直至1929或1930年，随后前往法国完成学业。他在法国停留至1935年夏，之后来到上海。

1930年至1933年间，雷特在索邦大学（巴黎）、南锡大学（Nancy）和卡昂大学（Caen）攻读法律、经济学和商业科学，已秘密查阅了雷特获得的文凭，这几乎毫无疑问地表明，在上述期间，他确实在正当利用时间进行学习。

1933年和1934年，雷特在巴黎受雇于一位名叫 M. **〔此处转录不清〕** 的人，地址为巴黎小马厩街（Passage des Petites Ecuries）20号。
